title: Kane 2025-26 v Lewandowski 2019-20: Bayern's best number nine season?
checked: Lewandowski 2019-20: 34 Bundesliga, 55 all comps, 15 CL; Kovac sacked Nov 2019, Flick in; four goals in 14 min 31 s at Red Star, 26 Nov 2019 (FC Bayern, CNN); 8-2 v Barcelona, 1-0 v PSG (Coman), 11 wins from 11, treble (Wikipedia season + final, UEFA); 2020 Ballon d'Or cancelled (Wikipedia, France Football). Bundesliga season records: Lewandowski 41 (20-21), Muller 40 (71-72). Kane 2025-26: 61 in 51 for Bayern, 36 Bundesliga, 14 CL, 10 Pokal; Supercup, league, Pokal; out to PSG 6-5; Ballon d'Or 2026 (Bundesliga.com, FC Bayern, RTE, FootballTransfers). Red Star clip is a game goal from that night, not one of the four like for like.

lines.text: Same club, same shirt, same number nine. Kane's seventy-three goals, or Lewandowski's treble?
lines.say: Same club, same shirt, same number nine. Kayn's seventy-three goals, or Lehvandoffskee's treble?

lines.text: November 2019. Bayern lose five-one at Frankfurt and sack their manager. Hansi Flick takes over.
lines.say: November twenty nineteen. Byern lose five, one at Frankfurt and sack their manager. Hansee Flick takes over.

scene.headline: Bayern sack Kovac after Frankfurt thrashing
scene.standfirst: A 5-1 defeat ends his reign. Assistant Hansi Flick takes charge. Nobody expects what happens next.

lines.text: Weeks later in Belgrade, Robert Lewandowski scores four goals in fourteen minutes. A Champions League record.
lines.say: Weeks later in Belgrayd, Robbert Lehvandoffskee scores four goals in fourteen minutes. A Champions League record.

lines.text: Thirty-four league goals. Fifty-five in all. Fifteen in the Champions League.

lines.say: Then Lisbon. Eight, two against Barcelona.

lines.text: And in the final, Coman's header beats PSG. Eleven games, eleven wins. The treble.
lines.say: And in the final, Comahn's header beats P S G. Eleven games, eleven wins. The treble.

lines.text: Then the cruel bit. That year, the Ballon d'Or was cancelled.
Six years later, Harry Kane wears the same shirt. Sixty-one goals for Bayern. Thirty-six in the league.
lines.say: Six years later, Harry Kayn wears the same shirt. Sixty-one goals for Byern. Thirty-six in the league.

lines.text: But in the Bundesliga, the record is still Lewandowski's. Forty-one, a year after the treble.
lines.say: But in the Bundesleega, the record is still Lehvandoffskee's. Forty-one, a year after the treble.

lines.text: Kane won the league, and the cup with a hat-trick in the final.
lines.say: Kayn won the league, and the cup with a hat-trick in the final.

lines.text: But PSG again. Bayern went out in the semi, six-five. Kane's last goal came in stoppage time.
lines.say: But P S G again. Byern went out in the semi, six, five. Kayn's last goal came in stoppage time.

lines.text: Kane has more goals and a Ballon d'Or. Lewandowski has the Champions League.
lines.say: Kayn has more goals and a Ballon d'Or. Lehvandoffskee has the Champions League.

lines.text: Goals win awards. Trebles win arguments. Lewandowski.
lines.say: Goals win awards. Trebles win arguments. Lehvandoffskee.

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
